art.title: John Tait and His Grandson
art.why: An old man holds up a pocket watch for a child: Paley's watch, seen by someone who has never seen one before

art.title: The Equatorial Jungle
art.why: Two animals half-hidden in a wall of tropical growth: the crowded life Darwin met in Brazil (Heade's hummingbirds and Church's Rio de Luz are used)

art.title: Luxuriant Forest on the Bank of the Amazon
art.why: A bank clothed with dense vegetation: the 'tangled bank' (South American, not an English hedgerow). NGA description is thin: keep the look short
No starry-sky painting in the collection (searched stars, night, moon)

art.title: Lion Defending its Prey
art.why: Lion over a deer's carcass, blood, a snake: nature red in tooth and claw (c. 1840, the decade of In Memoriam)

art.title: The Cornell Farm
art.why: Speckled and brindled cows, sheep, pigs suckling, horses and fields: the 'landscape plotted and pieced' of Pied Beauty (Inness's harvest scene was taken)

music.why: Haydn's Creation (1798): the ordered, designed world Paley's England believed in
